Zorunlu alanlar randevunun kurulması ve: Mandatory fields are used to set up and secure the appointment.
İsteğe bağlı notlara sağlık veya diğer ö: We recommend not entering health data or other special categories of personal data in optional notes.
İptal, değişiklik ve bildirim kayıtları: Cancellation, change and notification records may be kept for transaction security.
Veriler; barındırma, kimlik doğrulama, b: Data may be shared with hosting, authentication, notification, email or SMS, and security service providers to the extent required by the service; with the selected business for the purpose of carrying out the appointment; and with competent authorities where legally required. Where data is transferred abroad, the appropriate safeguards under Article 9 of KVKK are applied.
Kayıtlar işleme amacı, sözleşme ilişkisi: Records are kept for the duration of the processing purpose, the contractual relationship, any dispute and the retention obligations arising from legislation; when the period ends, they are deleted, destroyed or anonymized. Measures such as authorization, access logging, encrypted transmission, backups and role-based access are applied.
KVKK'nın 11. maddesi kapsamında verinizi: Under Article 11 of KVKK, you have the right to learn whether your data is processed, to request information about it, to learn the purpose of processing and whether it is used in line with that purpose, to know the third parties to whom it is transferred, to request its correction, deletion or destruction, to request that these actions be notified to recipients, to object to outcomes based on automated processing, and to claim compensation in case of damage.
Başvuruda ad-soyad, iletişim bilgisi, ta: Your application should include your full name, contact details, the subject of the request and information verifying your identity.
Başvurular kural olarak en geç 30 gün iç: As a rule, applications are concluded within 30 days at the latest.
Talebinizi info@seninrandevun.com adresi: You can send your request to info@seninrandevun.com with the subject KVKK Application.
Bu metin hizmet, işleme faaliyetleri vey: This notice may be updated when the service, processing activities or legislation change. Material changes are announced through appropriate channels; the current version of the notice is published on this page.
SeninRandevun web ve mobil hizmetlerinde: Learn what information is collected in SeninRandevun web and mobile services, how it is used and protected, and how you can manage your preferences.
SeninRandevun web, iOS ve Android hizmet: Explains in plain language how information is protected in SeninRandevun's web, iOS and Android services and how you can manage your preferences.
Bu politika ziyaretçiler, randevu alan m: This policy applies to visitors, customers who book appointments, business owners, business staff and people who use the support channels. Businesses may have additional notices for their own customer processes.
Hesap ve iletişim bilgileri; işletme, hi: Account and contact information; business, service and staff profiles; appointment details; support messages; and device, session, IP and security logs may be processed. Fields are limited to the purpose, and no unnecessary special categories of personal data are requested.
Hesap ve randevu hizmetini sunmak, kimli: We use it to provide the account and appointment service, verify identity and phone numbers, prevent double bookings, send notifications, prevent fraud, provide support and fulfill legal obligations. Analytics and marketing technologies run only with your choice.
Randevu bilgileri seçtiğiniz işletmeyle;: Appointment information may be shared with the business you choose; technical data may be shared, limited to the purpose, with hosting, notification, SMS or email, error monitoring and security providers. Personal data is not sold. Disclosures to competent authorities are made only where there is a valid legal obligation.
Veriler amaç ve yasal yükümlülük sürdüğü: Data is kept for as long as the purpose and legal obligations continue, and is then deleted, destroyed or anonymized. Encrypted transmission, access control, role separation, logging, backups and regular security checks are applied.
Çerez panelinden zorunlu olmayan kategor: You can turn non-essential categories on and off individually from the cookie panel. You can change notification and account preferences from the relevant panel, and you can contact info@seninrandevun.com regarding your KVKK rights.
Hizmet çocuklara yönelik tasarlanmamıştı: The service is not designed for children. If you believe that a transaction relating to a minor has been carried out without the supervision of a parent or legal guardian, please contact us.
Esaslı politika değişikliklerini uygulam: We announce material policy changes within the app or through appropriate communication channels. For questions, you can write to info@seninrandevun.com.
SeninRandevun işletme paketlerinin elekt: Electronic delivery of SeninRandevun business plans: there is no shipping; the plan is added to your account instantly upon payment approval.
SeninRandevun bir yazılım hizmetidir. Sa: SeninRandevun is a software service. Purchased plans are not physical products; there is no shipping or hand delivery, and the service is provided electronically.
Satışı yapılan işletme paketleri bulut t: The business plans sold are a right to use cloud-based software. There are no shipping, dispatch or delivery fees; address information is used only for billing purposes.
Ödeme, ödeme kuruluşu tarafından onaylan: The plan is automatically assigned to the business account as soon as the payment is approved by the payment institution; this usually takes a few seconds. The plan's status and expiration date are displayed on the Subscription screen in the business dashboard and in the mobile apps.
Hizmet seninrandevun.com işletme paneli: The service is used through the seninrandevun.com business dashboard and the SeninRandevun iOS and Android apps, from anywhere with an internet connection. No additional setup or software installation is required.
Aylık paket 1 takvim ayı, yıllık paket 1: A monthly plan is valid for 1 calendar month and an annual plan for 1 calendar year. If there is an ongoing trial or subscription period, the new term is added from the end of that period. The plan does not renew automatically.
Ödemeniz alındığı halde paketiniz 24 saa: If your payment has been received but your plan has not been assigned within 24 hours, report it to {email} or {phone} with the payment date and your business name. If the problem cannot be resolved within 3 business days, your payment is refunded in full under the Cancellation and Refund Policy.
